section_title: Configure asset, strategy, and horizon the engine should read
section_intro: The homepage does not invent a winner. It shows where cost tends to concentrate for the selected combination before the full ranking runs.
strategy_hint: Available strategies change according to asset and horizon.
capital_hint: Capital shifts the balance between fixed and variable costs.
insight_scalping: In scalping, cost concentrates almost entirely in execution.
insight_intraday: In intraday trading, cost concentrates in execution as friction repeats.
insight_swing: In swing, execution and carry begin to stack together.
insight_position: In position trading, holding cost becomes dominant.
read_group_forex: Forex: spread, financing and trading session change the profile.
read_group_indices: Indices: execution quality and funding matter more than expected.
read_group_equities: Equities: margin and holding costs matter as much as selection.
read_group_crypto: Crypto: market structure and funding influence results.
read_group_commodities: Commodities: rollover and contract structure weigh on net results.
read_horizon_scalping: Scalping: the engine prioritizes execution friction and slippage.
read_horizon_intraday: Short holding: the engine prioritizes execution drag and turnover.
read_horizon_swing: Intermediate holding: execution and carry begin to stack.
read_strategy_market_making: Market making: bid-ask spread and liquidity are everything.
read_strategy_spread_hunting: Spread hunting: advantage depends on effective spread.
read_strategy_breakout_intraday: Breakout: slippage and timing amplify errors.
read_strategy_range_trading: Range trading: holding costs weigh more.
read_strategy_trend_following: Trend following: carry can weigh as much as setup.
read_strategy_mean_reversion: Mean reversion: precise execution and contained costs.
read_strategy_carry_trade: Carry trade: funding determines the result.
read_capital_small: Compact capital: fixed costs weigh heavily.
read_capital_large: Large capital: percentage cost becomes more visible.
read_leverage_off: No leverage: profile stays close to direct instrument.
preview_note: Qualitative indicator based on the selected combination.
